symptoms: Dark, concentric spots on lower leaves
organic_management: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves
chemical_management: Use a locally approved fungicide according to the product label and local agricultural guidance.
prevention: Rotate crops — avoid tomato/potato in the same bed consecutively
Water at the base, not on foliage
Tomato___Early_blight.caution: Do not compost infected plant material.

symptoms: Large, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves
White mold on the underside of leaves
organic_management: Copper hydroxide spray applied preventatively before wet weather
Destroy infected plants immediately — this disease spreads fast
chemical_management: Use a locally approved systemic fungicide according to the product label.
prevention: Ensure good drainage and airflow between plants
Remove volunteer potato/tomato plants that can carry the pathogen between seasons
Tomato___Late_blight.caution: Late blight can destroy entire crops quickly. Act immediately.

prevention: Continue routine monitoring for early symptoms
Maintain consistent watering and balanced fertilization

organic_management: Copper-based fungicide, applied before disease pressure builds, especially in cool wet conditions.
chemical_management: Use a locally approved fungicide according to the product label and local agricultural guidance.
prevention: Hill soil around plants to protect tubers
Destroy infected plant debris after harvest
Potato___Late_blight.caution: Late blight is highly contagious among solanaceous crops.

symptoms: Small, reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces
organic_management: Generally tolerable at low levels; remove severely affected leaves in home garden settings.
chemical_management: Use a locally approved fungicide if infection is severe and early in the season, per local guidance.
prevention: Plant rust-resistant corn varieties where available
Avoid dense planting that limits airflow
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust.caution: Avoid planting susceptible varieties in consecutive seasons.

organic_management: Consult a local agricultural extension office for organic treatment options for this specific disease.
chemical_management: Use a locally approved treatment according to the product label and local agricultural guidance.
